string.text: Chance an NPC gives the beckon greeting when you get close. Independent of the PDA.
Chance he also pulls out a PDA when you get close.
Chance a commander checks a PDA while standing idle.
Chance a calm standing NPC near you checks a PDA.
Recovering wounded NPCs play a get-up animation instead of snapping upright.

How a relaxed, free-standing NPC holds its torso. 
 Player pose: every NPC shares the player's lowered-weapon idle (vanilla). 
 Own idle: each NPC uses its base idle. 
 Varied: each NPC keeps one of the pack's idle variants. 
 Needs the latest demonized exes; ignored on older builds.

How much the xAGNA script layer writes to xagna.log. 
 Error: failures only. 
 Warning (default): failures and skipped edits. 
 Info: also the game-start summary of applied edits. 
 Debug: the full per-event trace of every PDA, wounded, and animation-table change.
Samples which animation states nearby NPCs actually play and writes them to xagna_animations.log. Independent of the log level; use it to confirm the mod's motions fire.

Write each log line to disk at once instead of buffering. Turn on when diagnosing a crash so the final lines survive a hard freeze that never reaches the periodic flush. Slower; leave off for normal play.
